notes: Goblin definitions use GoblinDefinition fields from the public root package.
Registry files use a top-level goblins array.
Worker image maps use a top-level workers object keyed by goblin kind.
Durable events add a sequence while pre-sequence EventRecord construction remains valid.
Kubernetes artifact retention keeps result and artifact JSON shapes stable and adds verified metrics.
Job statuses, Run statuses, result envelopes, and existing constructor requirements are unchanged.
Kubernetes runtime image settings are additive; legacy constructor and Helm tag-only values remain valid.
Kubernetes workload security defaults to the legacy generated Pod shape; restricted-v1 is an explicit opt-in profile.
The versioned restricted-v1 result-forwarder defaults are a 64Mi memory request and 128Mi memory limit; the legacy Pod shape and public settings fields are unchanged.

Generic Kubernetes validation is additive: Docker remains the CLI default, existing validation fields remain, artifacts/logs default empty, and Kubernetes proof shares typed runtime settings with scheduling.
SQLite auto-create and auto-alter behavior is internal and not a compatibility promise.
